editorial.blurb: Matilda is a stunning dining destination where inventive, beautifully presented Mexican-Japanese fusion food and impeccable service create one of Chicago's most memorable meals.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weeknight to avoid the crowds and speakeasy line; ask your server (David and Fernando are standouts) for mocktail recommendations even if you don't drink, and order family-style to experience as many dishes as possible.
